logic: What GET /api/donations/payment-details serves for the foundation's account (PaymentDetails.of, SpaydText): the account number and IBAN as configured, CZK, the recipient name as SPAYD text of at most 35 characters, the donation and account-verification messages as SPAYD text of at most 60 characters, and the 1 Kč of an account verification in hellers. SPAYD text strips diacritics, writes upper case, turns every character outside 0-9, A-Z, space, $, +, -, ., / and : into a space (so % and * become spaces), collapses spaces, trims, cuts and trims again. Only the backend computes it: the backend runs every case through the endpoint for the foundation's account and through PaymentDetailsService for another recipient, and the browser takes the texts as they come; from slice 1.4 spayd() composes the SPAYD text from them, which payment/spayd.json specifies
